Messages.Author: massimo isola
Messages.Body:
What happens if both vamps in combat play a Trap before range?
Is there a double press to continue each round for three rounds, or the
two presses cancel each other? How does it work?

Thank you.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From massimo isola <sund...@tin.it> =====

>What happens if both vamps in combat play a Trap before range?

>Is there a double press to continue each round for three rounds [...]

Yes.
The same situation occurs if one minion plays both traps.
It then takes two presses (both "to end") to end combat during
the press step of a given round - the same minion can play both
presses to end (since he's not then canceling his own press).
